# Decisions

Decisions about the airgap agent: why it exists, how it works, and how this repo works. Made by its maintainers, in
[MADR](https://adr.github.io/madr/) form, one small decision per record. Accepted records are never edited; a change is
a new record that replaces one. Words follow [GLOSSARY.md](../../GLOSSARY.md). The index below is generated from the
records by `./gradlew buildDecisionIndexes`.
